definitions.explanation: The country of Canada, occupying most of northern North America. Its official languages are English and French.

examples.english: My older brother lives in Canada.

examples.japanese: カナダ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦フランス{語|ご}→フランス語：24509_furansugo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話|はな}されている→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: English and French are spoken in Canada.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ワーキングホリデー→ワーキングホリデー：30079_waakinguhoridee⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧カナダ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: Every year many young people visit Canada on a working holiday.

notes:
The country of Canada, in northern North America. Always written in katakana.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カナダ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧: a Canadian
- カナダ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to study abroad in Canada
- カナダ{産|さん}: Canadian-made; from Canada
- ⟦{首都|しゅと}→首都：03224_shuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧オタワ: the capital is Ottawa

USAGE:
A popular destination for Japanese working-holiday participants and language study.
